standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 443 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light

IF xiaomi_presence_sensor.get_illuminance() > 443 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 24 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 21 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 24 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 21 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_PM2_5() > 35 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.08 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
